items.where: corner-less tower right of the gable (s 21.7-26.5): brick shaft with three-light stone-mullioned windows on five storeys, a corbelled set-back at 24.4 m, tall louvred lights in the top and a steep cap to 42.6 m
items.how: 3DBAG LoD2.2 cap and top (brick) above 24.4 m; the shaft below drawn as a cut section with 3 x 5 cross windows, arched top row, stone bands, corbel course and dark slabs for the louvred lights

items.where: club front gable (s 12.6-21.7): pointed brick gable from the 24.4 m cornice to 30.6 m over a row of white stone corbel blocks and stone consoles, a round window in the gable
items.how: 3DBAG gable plane kept above the cut at 24.4 m; corbel blocks and consoles as slabs on a 0.75 m pitch, stone coping, oculus as a stone ring over glass

items.where: stone frontispiece over the ground and first floors of the club front: two segmental shop arches under hood mouldings on carved consoles, five cross windows, a pierced tracery balustrade along the top
items.how: cut stone section with segmental openings (rise 0.55) and arch rings as hoods; consoles as stone blocks; cross windows with transoms; balustrade as dark panels behind stone ring tracery (two quatrefoil rings and a small ring per bay) between stone dies, a coping slab

items.where: DE INDUSTRIEELE GROOTE CLUB carved in an arc over the club entrance arch, a crown above
items.how: venue-kit arcLettering (new): MIXED_CASE glyph runs on a 4.0 m arc about the arch axis, 0.24 m letters dark in the stone; crown as gold slabs

items.where: brick storeys: five two-tier cross windows per floor in stone-dressed openings (sill, lintel, transom), round-headed attic lights; tower three-light groups; Dam 21 house cross windows in stone surrounds
items.how: street-front-kit cut openings with white frames, transom bars and two-light mullions, stone sill and lintel slabs

items.where: round-arched carriage passage (3.5 m) through the stone ground floor of the passage wing
items.how: round-headed cut opening 0.8 m deep, dark back, stone arch ring

items.where: Dam 21 house: three-sided stone-based oriel of four round-arched lights over the ground floor, with a balcony and balustrade on top
items.how: a flat-fronted 0.6 m box on a stone corbel with four round-arched glass lights in stone, a balcony slab, balusters and rail (the canted sides are not drawn)

items.where: arched corbel table under the passage wing eaves (14.3 m) and the east wing cornice
items.how: stone corbel blocks on a 0.42 m pitch carrying a brick band and a stone coping; the small arches between them are not cut

items.where: Gassan arcade: stone ground storey with round-arched shop windows, 5.3 m terrace roof; the east wing above set back 1.6-2.7 m
items.how: cut stone section with round-headed openings and arch rings; wing windows as arched glass and stone slabs on the 3DBAG wing wall

items.where: Ripley's Believe It or Not! letters over the Dam 21 shop arch, GASSAN letters on the arcade, Tours & Tickets and Amsterdam shop signs

skip.note: tenant signs, not the building (the club name is modelled)

items.where: club flag on a pole from the east wing
street lanterns on the pavement in front of the arcade
